name: skatteberegner-planlaegning
description: Kør what-if-analyser på din langsigtede økonomiske plan, beregn dansk skat og gem scenarier.
long_description:
Local MCP server for the **Skatteberegner** app (https://skat.simonottosen.dk).

It gives an assistant access to your own saved financial plan so it can answer questions like "what happens if I retire at 62?" or "how much more do I need to save each month to hit 3 million by 60?" — and, when you ask it to, save the answer as a named scenario that shows up in the web app.

**Tools cover four areas**

- *Planning* — read the plan, simulate a change without saving, solve for a required monthly contribution, project a year-by-year trajectory, and manage named scenarios.
- *Tax* — read your saved Danish tax profile or compute a fresh result (AM-bidrag, bund-/mellem-/top-/top-topskat, kommuneskat, kirkeskat, aktieindkomst, PAL-skat).
- *Budget* — read the saved budget and the combined result view.
- *Events* — add, edit and remove one-off and recurring life events (house purchase, sabbatical, inheritance, …).

**Because it runs locally** you sign in once instead of on every request, long Monte-Carlo runs are not cut short by a serverless timeout, and the assistant can open the relevant page of the app in your browser.

**Your data** stays between this machine and your own Supabase project. The server signs in as you and every query is constrained by row-level security to your own row — it cannot read anyone else's data. Set *Read-only mode* if you want the assistant to be able to look but not touch.

email.title: E-mail
email.description: The email you use to sign in to the Skatteberegner app.

password.title: Adgangskode
password.description: Your Skatteberegner password. Stored in your operating system's keychain, never written to the bundle.

app_url.title: App-URL
app_url.description: Where the app is hosted. Change this only if you run your own copy.

read_only.title: Skrivebeskyttet
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes the saved plan. The assistant can read and simulate, but not save, edit or delete.

disable_open.title: Åbn ikke browseren
disable_open.description: Stop the assistant from opening pages on your screen. It will hand you the link instead.

tool_timeout_ms.title: Timeout pr. værktøj (ms)
tool_timeout_ms.description: Abort a tool call that takes longer than this. Monte-Carlo projections are the slow ones.

log_level.title: Logniveau
log_level.description: How much the server writes to the host's log: debug, info, warn, error or silent.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read the full saved long-term plan plus the baseline projection (net worth at retirement, pension after tax, financial-independence age, Monte-Carlo success probability).

tools.name: simulate_what_if
tools.description: Project the impact of a change without saving it. Returns baseline, modified plan and the deltas.

tools.name: solve_required_saving
tools.description: Solve for the monthly contribution needed to hit a target amount at a given age.

tools.name: get_trajectory
tools.description: Year-by-year projection of net worth, contributions and withdrawals.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Write changes to the saved plan (assumptions, pension, retirement age, …).

tools.name: save_scenario
tools.description: Persist a named what-if so it appears in the app's Scenarier card.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: List the saved scenarios with their change-sets.

tools.name: update_scenario
tools.description: Rename a saved scenario or change its change-set.

tools.name: get_tax
tools.description: Read the saved Danish tax profile and its calculated result.

tools.name: compute_tax
tools.description: Calculate Danish income tax for a given set of inputs without saving anything.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Read the saved budget: income, expenses by category and the monthly surplus.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Read the combined result view — take-home pay against the budget.

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Add a one-off or recurring life event to the plan (house purchase, sabbatical, inheritance, …).

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open a page of the app in the default browser on this machine.

prompts.name: plan_review
prompts.description: Review the saved plan and suggest concrete improvements.
prompts.text: Read my saved plan with get_plan. Summarise where I stand — net worth at retirement, pension after tax, financial-independence age and the Monte-Carlo success probability. Then name the two or three changes that would most improve the outcome, and use simulate_what_if to quantify each one. Do not save anything unless I ask.

prompts.name: retire_earlier
prompts.description: Work out what it would take to retire earlier than planned.
prompts.text: I want to retire at ${arguments.age}. Use get_plan for my current position, then simulate_what_if to see what retiring at that age does to the projection. If it falls short, use solve_required_saving to tell me the monthly contribution that would close the gap. Report amounts in today's kroner.

prompts.name: tax_check
prompts.description: Explain this year's Danish tax bill and where it could be reduced.
prompts.text: Use get_tax to read my saved tax profile. Break the bill down — AM-bidrag, bundskat, mellemskat, topskat, topskat 2, kommuneskat, kirkeskat, aktieindkomst — and explain which brackets I am in and by how much. Then use compute_tax to test any adjustment that looks worthwhile, for example a larger pension contribution.
